newsitem.title: USA: American Restaurant tries dual branding.
newsitem.headline: American Restaurant tries dual branding.

text.p: American Restaurant Partners LP, reporting a third-quarter loss of $0.02 per share, said it is experimenting with dual branding in an attempt to bolster profitability.
"In October, we opened a combination Pizza Hut/Red Line Hamburger/ICBY Yogurt unit in a convenience store in Texas," said chairman Hal McCoy in a statement.

"We have a dual brand Pizza Hut/Taco Bell freestanding unit under construction in Montana. There are numerous opportunities to duplicate either one of these concepts if they are successful," he added.
Third-quarter results included a charge of $270,069 for the partnership's share of loss of an affiliate that owns 32 Pizza Huts in the Oklahoma City area.
